source: Harbourline test-drive incentives (stand-in). One is offered per booking, chosen by matching finder answers and the cars viewed. Fictional.
notes: rules are tried in order within each incentive; incentives are tried by descending priority. A rule matches on `answer` (canonical finder answer id + values, with a customer-facing phrase per value), `viewedTag` (catalogue model tag of any viewed car), `viewedPowertrain`, or `default`. {phrase} and {model} are filled in by the server.
